purpose: Ten alternative logo design directions, local comparison only

assets.title: Asztrális
assets.style: A spiritual celestial emblem: a graceful gecko coils beneath a delicate crescent halo, with a few precisely balanced stars and geometric arcs evoking quiet sacred geometry. Midnight navy canvas, luminous muted turquoise and a few antique gold accents. Restrained flat vector aesthetic, elegant geometric wordmark below the emblem. The gecko and electricity remain recognisable; calm mystical atmosphere, premium contemporary software identity. No ornate border or dense ornament.
assets.prompt:
Create one original professional logo concept for VoltGecko, a friendly and capable electrical installation planning app for floor plans, circuits and distribution boards. The symbol must read as a GECKO: one curved body, a tail and four splayed feet; integrate one elegant electrical lightning or circuit idea. Brand spelling exactly 'VoltGecko', uppercase V and G, no space. Include the exact brand wordmark, with no other text. Treat this as a usable identity design with a strong silhouette and considered clearspace, not an illustration poster or an interface. One single finished logo, mark plus wordmark, on a clean landscape 3:2 canvas, centered composition. No mockups, photographs, watermarks, captions, multiple options or contact sheet.
